defs.def: to ask God to protect sb/sth 求上帝降福；祝福

ex.s: In New York, a multicultural city, students like me are blessed with a chance to work with a diverse population.
ex.t: 在纽约这样一个多元文化城市，像我这样的学生有幸能与多样化的人群一起工作。

ex.s: （18）     ， I feel blessed someone had wanted to help a stranger． Erin had gone（19）     what almost anyone would have done， finding my house on a bitterly cold night and for that I was extremely（20）     ．

defs.def: to make sth holy by saying a prayer over it 祝圣

ex.s: In the words of Mark Twain, “Humor is mankind’s greatest blessing”.
ex.t: 用马克·吐温的话说：“幽默是人类最大的福分。”

ex.s: Three Days to See 1 I have often thought it would be a blessing if each human being were stricken blind and deaf for a few days at some time during his early adult life.
ex.t: 《假如给我三天光明》1 我常常想，如果在每个人成年初期，都能突然失明失聪几天，那将是一种福分。

ex.s: I’m blessed with many things: happiness, a cheerful disposition and strength.
ex.t: 我受惠于许多东西：幸福、开朗的性格和力量。

ex.s: Being in such a beautiful and wild place makes me feel blessed to be alive.
ex.t: 身处如此美丽而蛮荒的地方，让我感恩自己能活着。

ex.s: THREE DAYS TO SEE (Adapted) I have often thought it would be a blessing if each human being were stricken blind and deaf for a few days at some time during his early adult life.
ex.t: 《假如给我三天光明》（改编）我常常想，如果在每个人成年初期，都能突然失明失聪几天，那将是一种福分。

defs.def: to call God holy; to praise God 称颂上帝；赞美上帝
